item.title: Lindsey Vonn is preparing to fly home to the US with more surgeries to come, team official tells AP
item.description: The chief of the U.S. Ski Team says Lindsey Vonn is preparing to fly home to the United States a week after her terrifying head-over-heels crash in the Olympic downhill.

item.title: Missing UC Berkeley student found deceased in nearby lake, authorities say
item.description: The body of Saketh Sreenivasaiah, a missing 22-year-old UC Berkeley student was recovered at Lake Anza, authorities said.

item.title: Tyler Reddick wins NASCAR Daytona 500 for Michael Jordan-owned 23XI Racing
item.description: Tyler Reddick won the Daytona 500 in a car owned by Michael Jordan when Chase Elliott crashed as he and Reddick were battling for the win.

item.title: Robbery suspect injured after shot by police officer in Fremont, authorities say
item.description: An officer shot a robbery suspect in Fremont Saturday night, police said.

item.title: Former UFC heavyweight champion Cain Velasquez released from prison after 2022 shooting
item.description: Former UFC heavyweight champion Cain Velasquez was released from prison following a 2022 shooting, the California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation confirmed on Sunday. Velasquez was in prison for attempted murder of a man charged with molesting Velasquez's son.

item.title: 3 people injured, including firefighter, 1 dog dead in East San Jose house fire
item.description: San Jose firefighters responded to a two-alarm structure fire on the 10100 block of Endfield Way Sunday that injured three people, including a firefighter, and killed one dog.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Level 2 storm continues overnight; Winter Storm Warning for Tahoe area
item.description: A Level 2 storm continues overnight with pockets of downpours, gusty wind and a chance of thunderstorms. For Presidents' Day, rain will spread across our entire area with gusty conditions at times.

item.title: Winter storm could bring inches of rain to Bay Area and create hazardous driving in Sierra
item.description: Watch out. Some fierce, wet, windy weather is approaching the Bay Area. California Highway Patrol wants drivers to slow down out there.

item.title: Bay Area Day of Remembrance pays tribute to Japanese Americans interned during WWII in SF Japantown
item.description: A tribute to the more than 120,000 Japanese Americans imprisoned during World War II took place in San Francisco's Japantown Sunday.
